'''Wotson''' was a large [[Gender/Legends|male]] in the [[Peace Brigade]], a band of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] citizens that cooperated with [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] invaders called the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="AOCI" /> In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> alongside [[Ven (Peace Brigade)|Ven]], Wotson guarded [[Reck Desh]], the leader of the Brigade, when he traveled to [[Kuat City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. There, the trio visited a diner called the [[Nebula Orchid]] to meet an informant, secretly [[Viqi Shesh]]. Wotson and Ven sat at a nearby table while Shesh told Desh of a captured [[Elan|Yuuzhan Vong priestess]]. Once the meeting was over, the trio pursued the informant into the streets, but lost sight of the person.<ref name="AOCI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wotson briefly appeared in ''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]'', a [[2000]] novel written by [[James Luceno]] as the fourth volume in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' series.<ref name="AOCI" />
